name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta province of Argentina. The project hosts a large mineral resource of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold. The company is advancing Diablillos toward a development decision and also holds an earlier-stage copper-gold project, La Coipita, in San Juan province.
